parts.text: (ii) The price of a coat is reduced by 9 2 in a sale. The new price of the coat is $73.50 . Find the original price of the coat. $ ................................................. [2]

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Pedro invests $1000 in Bank C for 18 years. Pedro also invests $1000 in Bank D for 18 years. Bank C pays simple interest at a rate of x % each year. Bank D pays compound interest at a rate of 0.7 x % each year. At the end of 18 years Pedro has exactly the same amount of money in Bank C and Bank D .

content.tex: Pedro invests \(\$1000\) in Bank \(C\) for 18 years. Pedro also invests \(\$1000\) in Bank \(D\) for 18 years.

Bank \(C\) pays simple interest at a rate of \(x\%\) each year. Bank \(D\) pays compound interest at a rate of \(0.7x\%\) each year. At the end of 18 years Pedro has exactly the same amount of money in Bank \(C\) and Bank \(D\) .
Given that \(5 < x < 7\) , use a graphical method to find \(x\) .
